paras: The Alpha-N CSL Carbon Trunk Lid is designed to fit the BMW 3 Series G20 2019+ (pre-facelift G20.1 and facelift G20.2) and the BMW M3 G80 Sedan 2021+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this carbon fibre trunk lid takes direct inspiration from BMW's legendary CSL design language.

The integrated ducktail profile sharpens the rear of the G20 and G80 with a more purposeful look while contributing to improved aerodynamic balance. The sculpted ducktail spoiler generates additional rear downforce at speed, eliminating the need for a separate trunk-mounted spoiler and creating a clean, motorsport-ready aesthetic.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
Pre-preg 2x2 twill carbon fibre, sourced from Italy
Significant weight reduction over the factory trunk lid
Installs using factory mounting locations with OEM hardware transferred across
